groups.title: The rest of the Twelve, Matthias and Paul
The kings of Judah and Queen Athaliah
Israel before the kings: Moses, Joshua and the judges

rulers.name: Jeroboam I
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-two years: the first king of the ten tribes.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-two years (1 Kings 14:20)
prophets: The man of God from Judah

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Jeroboam returned not from his evil way

rulers.name: Nadab
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years, ended by a soldier's coup at Gibbethon.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 15:25)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Baasha
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-four years in Tirzah, after killing Nadab.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-four years (1 Kings 15:33)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Elah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years in Tirzah; killed while drinking.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 16:8)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin

rulers.name: Zimri
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Seven days in Tirzah.
rulers.reignText: Seven days (1 Kings 16:15)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Omri
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twelve years; the founder of Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Twelve years, six of them in Tirzah (1 Kings 16:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him

rulers.name: Ahab
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-two years in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-two years in Samaria (1 Kings 16:29)
prophets: One of the sons of the prophets

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him

rulers.name: Ahaziah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years; died of a fall in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 22:51)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Joram
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twelve years; the last king of Omri's house.
rulers.reignText: Twelve years (2 Kings 3:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother

rulers.name: Jehu
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-eight years in Samaria, after ending the house of Ahab.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-eight years in Samaria (2 Kings 10:36)
otherNames: Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart

rulers.name: Jehoahaz
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Seventeen years under Hazael's oppression.
rulers.reignText: Seventeen years (2 Kings 13:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoash
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years; three victories over Syria and one over Judah.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years (2 Kings 13:10)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jeroboam II
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Forty-one years in Samaria; Israel's borders restored.
rulers.reignText: Forty-one years in Samaria (2 Kings 14:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Zechariah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Six months; the last king of Jehu's house.
rulers.reignText: Six months (2 Kings 15:8)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done

rulers.name: Shallum
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: One month in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: “A full month” (2 Kings 15:13)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.name: Menahem
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Ten years in Samaria; tribute to Assyria.
rulers.reignText: Ten years in Samaria (2 Kings 15:17)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Pekahiah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years; killed in his own palace.
rulers.reignText: Two years (2 Kings 15:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Pekah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty years; Assyria takes Galilee and Gilead.
rulers.reignText: Twenty years (2 Kings 15:27)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Hoshea
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Nine years; the last king of Israel.
rulers.reignText: Nine years (2 Kings 17:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him

rulers.name: Rehoboam
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Seventeen years in Jerusalem, as the kingdom split in two.
rulers.reignText: Seventeen years, from the age of forty-one (1 Kgs 14:21; 2 Chr 12:13).
rulers.verdict: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Abijah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three years in Jerusalem, at war with Jeroboam.
rulers.reignText: Three years (1 Kgs 15:2; 2 Chr 13:2). His age at accession is not given.
rulers.verdict: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him

rulers.name: Asa
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Forty-one years in Jerusalem.
rulers.reignText: Forty-one years (1 Kgs 15:10); he died in his forty-first year (2 Chr 16:13). His age at accession is not given.
rulers.verdict: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.

rulers.name: Jehoshaphat
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-five years in Jerusalem, at peace with Ahab's house.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-five years, from the age of thirty-five (1 Kgs 22:42; 2 Chr 20:31).
rulers.verdict: doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoram
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eight years in Jerusalem, married into Ahab's house.
rulers.reignText: Eight years, from the age of thirty-two (2 Kgs 8:17; 2 Chr 21:5, 20). His mother is not named.
rulers.verdict: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Ahaziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: One year in Jerusalem, killed in Jehu's revolt.
rulers.reignText: One year (2 Kgs 8:26; 2 Chr 22:2). His age is twenty-two in Kings and forty-two in Chronicles.
rulers.verdict: and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as did the house of Ahab

rulers.name: Athaliah
rulers.title: Queen who reigned over Judah
rulers.tagline: Six years on David's throne, the only woman to reign over Judah.
rulers.reignText: Six years, while the boy Joash was hidden in the temple (2 Kgs 11:3; 2 Chr 22:12). Scripture gives her no regnal formula: no cross-date, age, verdict, source note or burial.
rulers.verdict: "Athaliah did reign over the land." That one sentence (in Chronicles, "Athaliah reigned over the land") is…

rulers.name: Joash
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Forty years in Jerusalem, crowned at seven.
rulers.reignText: Forty years, from the age of seven (2 Kgs 11:21; 12:1; 2 Chr 24:1).
rulers.verdict: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest…

rulers.name: Amaziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; victor over Edom, beaten by Israel.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-nine years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 14:2; 2 Chr 25:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father

rulers.name: Uzziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Fifty-two years in Jerusalem, the last of them as a leper.
rulers.reignText: Fifty-two years, from the age of sixteen (2 Kgs 15:2; 2 Chr 26:3). In his last years his son Jotham judged the people.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done

rulers.name: Jotham
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years in Jerusalem, after ruling for his leper father.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 15:33; 2 Chr 27:1, 8). Before that he was "over the house, judging the people" for his father.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Ahaz
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years in Jerusalem, Assyria's servant.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years, from the age of twenty (2 Kgs 16:2; 2 Chr 28:1). His mother is not named.
rulers.verdict: and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father

rulers.name: Hezekiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; "after him was none like him".
rulers.reignText: Twenty-nine years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 18:2; 2 Chr 29:1). Fifteen years were added to his life after his illness (2 Kgs 20:6).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

rulers.name: Manasseh
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Fifty-five years in Jerusalem, the longest reign in Judah.
rulers.reignText: Fifty-five years, from the age of twelve (2 Kgs 21:1; 2 Chr 33:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen

rulers.name: Amon
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Two years in Jerusalem, killed in his own house.
rulers.reignText: Two years, from the age of twenty-two (2 Kgs 21:19; 2 Chr 33:21).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

rulers.name: Josiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Thirty-one years in Jerusalem, from the age of eight.
rulers.reignText: Thirty-one years, from the age of eight (2 Kgs 22:1; 2 Chr 34:1).
prophets: The man of God from Judah (unnamed)
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoahaz
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three months in Jerusalem, then a prisoner of Egypt.
rulers.reignText: Three months, at the age of twenty-three (2 Kgs 23:31; 2 Chr 36:2).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

rulers.name: Jehoiakim
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eleven years in Jerusalem, under Egypt and then Babylon.
rulers.reignText: Eleven years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 23:36; 2 Chr 36:5).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

rulers.name: Jehoiachin
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three months in Jerusalem, thirty-seven years a captive in Babylon.
rulers.reignText: Three months (2 Kgs 24:8), or three months and ten days (2 Chr 36:9). Kings gives his age as eighteen, Chronicles as eight.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

rulers.name: Zedekiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eleven years in Jerusalem, the last king of Judah.
rulers.reignText: Eleven years, from the age of twenty-one (2 Kgs 24:18; 2 Chr 36:11; Jer 52:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

rulers.name: Moses
rulers.title: Leader of Israel, lawgiver and prophet
rulers.tagline: Forty years leading Israel from Egypt to the plains of Moab.
rulers.reignText: Forty years, from the Exodus to the plains of Moab
rulers.verdict: Stephen calls him the man whom Israel refused as "a ruler and a judge", and whom God sent "to be a ruler and…

rulers.name: Joshua
rulers.title: Leader of Israel after Moses
rulers.tagline: Led Israel over the Jordan and divided the land by lot.
rulers.reignText: Not given in Scripture: from Moses' death to his own death at 110
rulers.verdict: "A man in whom is the spirit"; "full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him".
rulers.capital: Gilgal, the first camp; later Shiloh

rulers.name: Othniel
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: The first judge: eight years under Cushan-rishathaim, then forty years of rest.
rulers.reignText: "The land had rest forty years"; then Othniel died
rulers.verdict: He took Kirjath-sepher (Debir) and received Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife.

rulers.name: Ehud
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Struck down Eglon of Moab; the land had rest eighty years.
rulers.reignText: Not given; after the victory "the land had rest fourscore years"
rulers.verdict: "The LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded."

rulers.name: Deborah
rulers.title: Prophetess and judge
rulers.tagline: Judged Israel under her palm tree; with Barak she broke Jabin of Hazor.
rulers.reignText: The years of her judging are not given; after the victory "the land had rest forty years"
rulers.verdict: "She dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of…
rulers.tribe: Not stated (she lived in mount Ephraim)

rulers.name: Gideon
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Three hundred men against Midian; forty years of quiet; he refused the crown.
rulers.reignText: Not given as years of judging; "the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon"
rulers.verdict: The angel of the LORD greeted him: "The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour."

rulers.name: Tola
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Rose "to defend Israel" after Abimelech; judged twenty-three years from Shamir.
rulers.reignText: Judged Israel 23 years
rulers.verdict: He was "a man of Issachar" who "dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim".

rulers.name: Jair
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: A Gileadite who judged twenty-two years; thirty sons on thirty ass colts.
rulers.reignText: Judged Israel 22 years
rulers.verdict: "He had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair…

rulers.name: Jephthah
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Chosen head of Gilead; broke Ammon; judged Israel six years.
rulers.reignText: "Jephthah judged Israel six years"
rulers.verdict: "Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah."

rulers.name: Ibzan
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Judged seven years from Beth-lehem; thirty sons and thirty daughters.
rulers.reignText: Judged Israel 7 years
rulers.verdict: "He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for…

rulers.name: Elon
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: A Zebulonite who judged Israel ten years.
rulers.reignText: Judged Israel 10 years
rulers.verdict: "Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years."

rulers.name: Abdon
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Judged eight years; forty sons and thirty nephews on seventy ass colts.
rulers.reignText: Judged Israel 8 years
rulers.verdict: "He had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight…

rulers.name: Samson
rulers.title: Judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: A Nazarite who judged Israel twenty years "in the days of the Philistines".
rulers.reignText: "He judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years"
rulers.verdict: "The child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand…

rulers.name: Eli
rulers.title: Priest and judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: The priest at Shiloh who judged Israel forty years.
rulers.reignText: "He had judged Israel forty years" (the Greek text reads twenty)
rulers.verdict: "Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD."

rulers.name: Samuel
rulers.title: Prophet and last judge of Israel
rulers.tagline: Judged Israel all his life from Ramah, and anointed its first two kings.
rulers.reignText: "Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life"; no number of years is given
rulers.verdict: "The LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground"; all Israel "knew that Samuel was…
rulers.tribe: Levi in 1 Chronicles 6; his father is called an Ephrathite of mount Ephraim (1 Samuel 1:1)

rulers.name: Saul
rulers.title: First king of Israel
rulers.tagline: The first king, chosen from Benjamin.
rulers.reignText: Forty years, by Acts 13:21. In 1 Samuel 13:1, where the age and length should stand, the Hebrew numbers are incomplete.
rulers.verdict: the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel

rulers.name: Ish-bosheth
rulers.title: King over Israel after Saul
rulers.tagline: Two years over Israel, with Abner beside him.
rulers.reignText: “reigned two years” (2 Samuel 2:10), while David was king in Hebron over Judah for seven years and six months.
rulers.verdict: Abner, captain of Saul's host, took Ish-bosheth to Mahanaim and made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites…

rulers.name: David
rulers.title: King of Judah, then of all Israel
rulers.tagline: Seven years in Hebron, thirty-three in Jerusalem.
rulers.reignText: Forty years: seven years and six months in Hebron over Judah, thirty-three in Jerusalem over all Israel and Judah (2 Samuel 5:4–5). 1 Kings 2:11 and 1 Chronicles 29:27 give the Hebron years as seven.
rulers.verdict: David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded…

rulers.name: Solomon
rulers.title: King of all Israel
rulers.tagline: Forty years in Jerusalem; the builder of the temple.
rulers.reignText: “forty years” in Jerusalem over all Israel (1 Kings 11:42; 2 Chronicles 9:30).

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father

apostles.name: Peter
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: A fisherman from Bethsaida, named first in every list of the Twelve.
apostles.home: Scripture says Philip “was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter” (John 1:44). In Capernaum Simon and Andrew had a house (Mark 1:21, 29), which Matthew calls “Peter’s house” (Matt 8:14).
apostles.trade: A fisherman, casting a net with his brother Andrew (Matt 4:18). James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were his “partners” (Luke 5:10).
apostles.ending: Jesus tells Peter that when he is old “another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not”. John adds…
apostles.tradition: Peter “endured not one nor two but many labours, and thus having borne his testimony went to his appointed place of…

apostles.name: Andrew
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Peter’s brother, and the first follower John’s Gospel names.
apostles.home: From Bethsaida, “the city of Andrew and Peter” (John 1:44). He and Simon had a house in Capernaum (Mark 1:21, 29).
apostles.trade: A fisherman with his brother Simon (Matt 4:18; Mark 1:16).
apostles.ending: Scripture says nothing of Andrew after the upper room (Acts 1:13).
apostles.tradition: When John was urged to write his Gospel, “it was revealed to Andrew, one of the apostles, that John should narrate all…

apostles.name: James son of Zebedee
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: A fisherman’s son from Galilee; the one apostle Scripture says was put to death.
apostles.home: Scripture does not name their town. They were fishing on the sea of Galilee near Capernaum when called, and went with Jesus to the house of Simon and Andrew there (Mark 1:19–21, 29).
apostles.trade: Fishermen in their father’s boat on the sea of Galilee (Matt 4:21; Mark 1:19–20), “partners with Simon” (Luke 5:10).
apostles.called: Matthew 4 · In the boat with Zebedee
apostles.ending: When James and John asked for the places of honour, Jesus told them, “Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of”…
apostles.tradition: The man who led James to the judgment seat was moved by his testimony, confessed himself a Christian, asked James’s…

apostles.name: John son of Zebedee
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: A fisherman’s son from Galilee; with Peter and James, one of the three Jesus took aside.
apostles.home: Scripture does not name their town. They were fishing on the sea of Galilee near Capernaum when called, and went with Jesus to the house of Simon and Andrew there (Mark 1:19–21, 29).
apostles.trade: Fishermen in their father’s boat on the sea of Galilee (Matt 4:21; Mark 1:19–20), “partners with Simon” (Luke 5:10).
apostles.called: Matthew 4 · In the boat with Zebedee
apostles.ending: Jesus told James and John, “Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of” (Mark 10:39).
apostles.tradition: John “did himself publish a Gospel during his residence at Ephesus in Asia”.

apostles.name: Philip
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: From Bethsaida; the one who told Nathanael, “Come and see.”
apostles.home: “Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter” (John 1:44); John calls it “Bethsaida of Galilee” (John 12:21).
apostles.ending: Scripture says nothing of Philip the apostle after the upper room (Acts 1:13).
apostles.tradition: Papias, “their contemporary”, heard “a wonderful tale from the daughters of Philip”; Eusebius says “Philip the apostle…

apostles.name: Bartholomew
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: A name in every list of the Twelve; perhaps the Nathanael of John’s Gospel.
apostles.home: Scripture gives no home for Bartholomew. Nathanael was “of Cana in Galilee” (John 21:2).
apostles.called: Luke 6 · Chosen as one of the Twelve
apostles.ending: Scripture says nothing of Bartholomew after the upper room (Acts 1:13), or of Nathanael after the morning by the sea…
apostles.tradition: Pantaenus “is said to have gone to India. It is reported that … he found the Gospel according to Matthew”, for…

apostles.name: Thomas
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Called Didymus; the apostle who said, “My Lord and my God.”
apostles.called: Luke 6 · Chosen as one of the Twelve
apostles.ending: Scripture says nothing of Thomas after the upper room (Acts 1:13).
apostles.tradition: “Parthia, according to tradition, was allotted to Thomas as his field of labor”.

apostles.name: Matthew
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Called from the tax office: “Follow me.”
apostles.home: Mark tells the call straight after Jesus came back to Capernaum and went out “by the sea side”, so the tax office stood at or near Capernaum by the order of events. No verse names his home town.
apostles.trade: A publican, a collector of taxes and tolls. He was “sitting at the receipt of custom” when Jesus called him, and Matthew's own list calls him “Matthew the publican”.
apostles.ending: Scripture's last mention of Matthew is Acts 1:13. It says nothing of where he went or how he died.
apostles.tradition: Heracleon, a Valentinian teacher, argued that confessing Christ by one's life counts as well as confessing him aloud…
writings: The Gospel according to Matthew (its traditional title)

apostles.name: James son of Alphaeus
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Named in every list of the Twelve, and nowhere else for certain.
apostles.ending: Scripture does not mention him after Acts 1:13 and records nothing of his death.
apostles.tradition: An Ethiopic “Martyrdom of Saint James” says James son of Alphaeus was stoned for preaching Christ and “buried by the…

apostles.name: Thaddaeus (Judas of James)
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Two names in the lists, and one question at the Last Supper.
apostles.ending: Scripture does not mention him after Acts 1:13 and records nothing of his death.
apostles.tradition: Eusebius says that after the ascension Thomas sent “Thaddeus, who was also numbered among the seventy disciples of…

apostles.name: Simon the Zealot
apostles.title: One of the Twelve
apostles.tagline: Known only by his name in the lists, and the word that marks it.
apostles.ending: Scripture does not mention him after Acts 1:13 and records nothing of his death.
apostles.tradition: The Golden Legend says Simon preached in Egypt, then went with Jude to Persia, where pagan priests killed them both.

apostles.name: Judas Iscariot
apostles.title: One of the Twelve, who betrayed Jesus
apostles.tagline: Named last in every Gospel list, as the one who betrayed Jesus.
apostles.home: “Iscariot” is most often explained as “man of Kerioth”, a town of Judah (Joshua 15:25), though Smith (1884) notes that the name has received many interpretations. Scripture does not say where he came from.
apostles.trade: He kept the common purse of the Twelve: he “had the bag”.

apostles.name: Paul
apostles.title: Apostle to the Gentiles
apostles.tagline: Persecutor of the church, called on the road to Damascus.
apostles.home: Born a Jew in Tarsus in Cilicia, “a citizen of no mean city”, and “brought up in this city” (Jerusalem) “at the feet of Gamaliel”.
apostles.trade: A tentmaker, who worked with his own hands to keep himself and those with him.
